criteria.question: does taste drive reach MN9 through the SEZ (Shiu et al. 2024) without spreading beyond the SEZ or driving motor neurons at unphysiological rates, and is the pathway wiring-specific?

protocol.drive: explicit argv types, else annotated sugar GRN types (SUGAR_GRN_PATTERNS, BM_ excluded), else the screen-selected MN9-driving gustatory types present (GUSTATORY_MN9_DRIVING), else every gustatory afferent type, else the sensory afferents onto MN9's top excitatory inputs
protocol.bitter: BITTER_GRN_PATTERNS matches (or the argv override), driven at 50 Hz together with the sugar drive
protocol.second_order: Fdg, Bract, Roundup, Zorro (Shiu names) each alone at 50 Hz; if absent, MN9's top 4 excitatory input types, which drive it by construction (F4 then not scored)
protocol.F1_drive: left afferents only (inferred side), at the lowest dose-curve rate giving MN9 >= 2 spikes/cell under bilateral drive, else 100 Hz
protocol.null: degree-preserving rewired null (flycns/graph.py rewire_null defaults), drive at 50 Hz
protocol.model: declared parameter set (LIFParams), electrical synapses on

F2b_extra_SEZ_quiet.rule: spikes outside the SEZ per neuron per second of drive (200 ms pulses only), sugar drive at 50 Hz, bootstrap over pulses: PASS if the 95% interval lies at or below 0.02 Hz

F2c_motor_rate_physiological.rule: mean rate of the recruited cb_motor cells over the time the drive was on, sugar drive at 50 Hz, bootstrap over pulses: PASS if the 95% interval lies above 0 and at or below 100 Hz

F1_laterality_matches_wiring.condition: MN9 responds to the left-only drive (ipsilateral + contralateral > 0) and both the functional and the structural laterality have a direction (neither is a tie); not met while MN9 does not fire under the declared parameters
F1_laterality_matches_wiring.rule: (MN9-R minus MN9-L) per pulse times the sign of the structural prediction (unsigned 2-hop synapse-weighted drive, R minus L), paired in one simulation, bootstrap over pulses: PASS if the 95% interval lies above 0

F3_bitter_suppresses.condition: a bitter GRN type resolves (BITTER_GRN_PATTERNS or the argv override)
F3_bitter_suppresses.rule: MN9 under sugar alone minus under sugar + bitter, both at 50 Hz: two separate simulations, each resampled over its own pulses: PASS if the 95% interval lies above 0

F4_second_order_sufficient.condition: Shiu's second-order names resolve (not the fallback to MN9's top excitatory inputs) and at least one of them is tried
F4_second_order_sufficient.rule: each second-order type alone at 50 Hz: MN9 spikes/cell per pulse, bootstrap over pulses, 95% interval above 0; PASS only if every type passes

F5_null_silent.condition: the real network responds: MN9 >= 0.5 spikes/cell at 50 Hz (point value); a silent null beside a silent network is not scored
F5_null_silent.rule: MN9 on the rewired null at 50 Hz, bootstrap over pulses: PASS if the 95% interval lies at or below 0.1 spikes/cell

not_scored.F2_dose_response_REPORTED: monotonic MN9 response over 10-200 Hz: reported only, since MN9 firing from afferent drive needs a mechanism the model lacks (results/feeding/mechanism.json)
not_scored.F1_shiu_contralateral_bias: Shiu's contralateral prediction concerns labellar sugar GRNs; tested with LB3b/LB3c in benchmarks/sugar_laterality.py

electrical: shakB gap junction, 1:1 relay; Tanouye & Wyman 1980; Allen et al. 2006
shakB gap junction, 1:1 relay; Allen et al. 2006; Phelan et al. 2008
JON->GF mixed synapse modelled as electrical; shakB-dependent (Pezier et al. 2016); mixed (Pezier et al. 2014); 3 mV target untraced; contact set from MaleCNS v1.0
JON->GF mixed synapse modelled as electrical; shakB-dependent (Pezier et al. 2016); mixed (Pezier et al. 2014); 3 mV target untraced; contact set from MaleCNS v1.0
intrinsic: all-or-none GF response; von Reyn 2014; Ache 2019. Fitted by pre-stated rule (smallest value giving 1-2 spikes/response, <=2 on the strongest gain quartile, P(response) 0.5-1, TTMn relay intact; benchmarks/fit_gf_adapt.py at >=40 trials). 45 mV at w_scale 0.4 with the per-GF JON calibration (refit 2026-10-11, cloud run 13, 40 trials; the strong-quartile constraint holds at exactly 2.0, its limit; 30 mV gives 2.75). Before: 10 mV at w_scale 0.3 (2026-10-10), 30 mV under the all-trials loom input, 15 mV from an undersampled 20-trial fit. 0 mV gives up to 15 spikes per loom (9.7 on average on the strongest-gain quartile).
sustained MN rates < 100 Hz; Azevedo 2020; McKellar 2020
